image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a cooked Dungeness crab served on a white plate. The crab's carapace is reddish-orange with some darker mottling. Several legs and claws are visible, appearing disjointed or broken as part of the meal preparation. A metal seafood fork rests in the foreground, interacting with a piece of crab shell/meat. The background includes blurred elements of the dish, possibly onions or other garnishes.
